restauracion.descripcion: The application is closed to other staff. Review access permissions before reopening it.
restauracion.vacio: There are no permission differences. Confirm the review to reopen the application.
restauracion.sin_persona: This person is not on this list.
restauracion.consecuencia: Apply restores the permissions held before restoration. Discard keeps those in the backup, including permissions removed later.
restauracion.abrir_consecuencia: The application remains closed until you decide every change and confirm the review.
restauracion.confirmacion_detalle: After confirmation, staff can sign in with the permissions you have reviewed.
restauracion.acceso_bloqueado: Permissions are being reviewed after restoring a backup. You can sign in when Administration finishes the review.
restauracion.cambios_pendientes: Decide what to do with every pending change before reopening the application.
restauracion.revision_propia: Ask another administrator to review changes to your permissions.
restauracion.referencia_invalida: The list of permissions held before restoration is invalid.
restauracion.sin_administracion: There is no administrator with valid access in both lists.
restauracion.equipo_no_disponible: The target team is missing from the backup. Ask IT to recover it before applying this change, or discard the change if you choose to keep the backup permissions.
restauracion.cambio_perfil: Changes to roles or their validity period
restauracion.cambio_equipo: Changes to team, job or their validity period
restauracion.no_pendiente: There is no pending review. You can continue working in the application.
